spec_features.spec_quote: Turn limit:** 20 (configurable). Prevents infinite spend on stubborn models.
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:75 default max_turns=20; agent.py:110 `for turn_number in range(1, self.max_turns + 1):` bounds the retry loop; wired in runner.py:50 `max_turns=20`. The loop terminates after max_turns iterations, ending the session.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as the loop's range bound; this is the primary stop. The session ends naturally when the loop exhausts.

spec_features.spec_quote: Timeout:** 5-minute wall-clock. Prevents hung API calls from destroying batch budgets.
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:112-115: `elapsed = time.time() - start_time` then `if elapsed >= self.wall_timeout_sec: logger.info(...); break`. Default 300.0s at agent.py:76, wired in runner.py:51 `wall_timeout_sec=300.0`. The break exits the retry loop.
spec_features.notes: Checked at the top of every turn and breaks the loop when exceeded. Note it only fires between turns, not during a hung API call (no per-call timeout), but it is genuinely compared and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: logger.info("Wall timeout reached at turn %d", turn_number)

spec_features.spec_quote: Token budget:** 200 k tokens/session. Hard ceiling for CI safety.
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:116-118: `if total_tokens >= self.token_budget: logger.info('Token budget exhausted...'); break`. total_tokens accumulated each turn (`total_tokens += in_tok + out_tok`), default 200_000 at agent.py:77, wired runner.py:52 `token_budget=200_000`. The break exits the loop.
spec_features.notes: total_tokens is computed AND compared against the budget AND breaks the loop, so it is enforced (unlike a measured-but-unused value).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: logger.info("Token budget exhausted at turn %d", turn_number)
